statements.t: Beyond varegacestat, we now have three programs in the clinic, with IM-1340 expected to become the fourth by year-end.
We are progressing the Phase 1 study of IM-1021, our ROR1-targeted ADC, and look forward to presenting updated Phase 1 data at ASH in December.”
The company plans to initiate a Phase 1 trial by year-end.
We are also advancing a broad portfolio of early-stage ADCs pursuing undisclosed solid tumor targets.
